title: 铁路教学标的：规格升版后的联动修改（保留有效旧约束）

task.goal: 规格升版（REQ-1 v2，按站调整发车时间）后完成联动修改：替换被 v2 取代的约束，同时保留仍未被取消的旧约束（占用检查、发布判断）与既有测试行为；上下文须能区分该替换与该保留。
givens: specs/requirement-schedule.md 含 v2 升版记录
rules/interval-rule.md 等旧约束仍然有效
task.contract:
The competition rules require the full chain to keep working after the change (timetable calculation, vehicle-occupation re-check, publish gating).
Minimum interface contract (hidden acceptance tests will import exactly these): src/schedule.py gains adjust_departure(train, new_start) -> Train and src/api.py gains submit_adjust_departure(train, new_start) -> dict of stop -> "HH:MM".
